legacy_audit.scope: Read-only source catalogue and disposable saved-row probes; no game/human database audit or edits.
legacy_audit.compatibility: No bulk conversion, refunds or migrations. Preserve all raw reads. Up advances only a legal stage. Max fills any nonnegative raw bonus below the allowed cap for a boostable move. Maxed, out-of-range and unboostable rows remain unchanged for staff review.

mechanics_references.basis: PP Up/PP Max check boost count, calculate capacity delta and add only that delta to current PP; decompiled reference source.
calculatePP uses base*(5+ppUps)/5 and noPPBoosts; repository uses integer storage and its current modern dex.

setup_and_cleanup.fixture_setup: Fresh private loopback cluster; isolated schemas; tagged ordinary pokemon.user.User characters, real Trainer.add_item and production Pokemon creation/placement. No migration runner.
setup_and_cleanup.transport_adapters: Capture session output and menu exit; delegate actual User lookup/deposit; production command parse/func and SQL models. Success effects are not mocked.
setup_and_cleanup.fault_injection: Failed/partially failed debit, exceptions after boost/current PP SQL, outer rollback and postcommit transport failure.

preliminary_runs.diagnosis: 31/34 passed; fixture used missing inventory cache on generic ObjectDB and assumed released Pokemon still existed. Use the real User typeclass and permit missing released SQL rows.
Real User creation already creates trainer/storage. Fixture corrected to reuse production-created rows instead of duplicate inserts.
32/34 passed. Real User has the inventory updater directly but no legacy typeclass wrapper; confirmed callback lookup defect.
Confirmed real User and trainer.user both have _update_inventory_cache_from_trainer, while typeclass is None. Fixed the callback fallback; retained commit-only behavior.
37/37 passed after adding ambiguous Pokemon, fainted-state preservation and postcommit transport coverage; final frozen verification then reran all checks.
